status: Research and task design; no business implementation or deployment
privacy: Only aggregate metadata and synthetic examples. No conversation text, vectors, credentials, platform references or raw provider requests.

bot_sample.method: 25 Hz nonblocking py-spy plus cgroup counters; temporary profiler removed
bot_sample.qualification: Not a leak test or per-function CPU attribution; waiting-thread samples are not CPU work.

participation.qualification: Snapshot lengths are not physical disk writes or RSS. An unchanged chat watermark does not exclude other real source changes.

dream.qualification: Metadata did not decode or validate vector bodies; unchanged partitions can be skipped in incremental operation.

sticker_single_readonly_probe.qualification: Help/import and read-only SQL/file probe, not historical end-to-end latency. No business search, index rebuild or send.

memory_tool_receipt.qualification: Current independent read-only engine did not measure historical runtime queue, insert, commit or scheduler waiting.

artifact_and_route.qualification: Large artifacts exist; their use of the quadratic paging branch was not established. A Gemini model name does not imply native Gemini protocol.

paging_correctness_cases.case: JSON string legal final page rejected

dream_graph.qualification: Object structure sizes, not RSS. Graph construction/post-processing timings excluded real vector multiplication.

dot_product.qualification: Same multiply order and fsum on validated vectors; not an end-to-end or production speedup.

work_record_cache.qualification: Real put_record with persistence replaced by encoding counter, no physical file IO.

cumulative_opaque_checkpoints.qualification: Conditional cumulative checkpoint shape; not triggered by the inspected AGM responses.
